answer: An agent economy can anchor each identity to a licensed harbor pilot's season guiding small boats through one named tidal inlet. The pilot logs every transit as a unique echo-sounder trace of the channel, countersigned by the harbor master, so the record cannot be copied or bought. Random checks summon the holder to run a live echo sweep at their inlet within hours, and one operator cannot staff two inlets at once. Each extra fake identity needs another real pilot season, another harbor license, and a fee in outside money that doubles per identity on the same funding trail.
